title.zh: 规定第696号法拨付的200万美元不仅可用于购买铸造菲律宾银比索所需的银锭，还可用于铸币费用、将铸成的硬币从美国造币厂运往菲律宾群岛的运输费、保险及其他适当费用的法案。
title.en: AN ACT TO PROVIDE THAT THE APPROPRIATION OF TWO MILLIONS OF DOLLARS MADE IN ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND NINETY-SIX MAY BE EXPENDED NOT ONLY TO PURCHASE THE SILVER BULLION WITH WHICH TO COIN SILVER PHILIPPINE PESOS BUT ALSO TO PAY THE EXPENSES OF SUCH COINAGE AND THE TRANSPORTATION OF THE COINS, WHEN COINED, FROM THE MINTS OF THE UNITED STATES TO THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS, INCLUDING INSURANCE AND ALL OTHER PROPER EXPENSES.
title.orig: AN ACT TO PROVIDE THAT THE APPROPRIATION OF TWO MILLIONS OF DOLLARS MADE IN ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND NINETY-SIX MAY BE EXPENDED NOT ONLY TO PURCHASE THE SILVER BULLION WITH WHICH TO COIN SILVER PHILIPPINE PESOS BUT ALSO TO PAY THE EXPENSES OF SUCH COINAGE AND THE TRANSPORTATION OF THE COINS, WHEN COINED, FROM THE MINTS OF THE UNITED STATES TO THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS, INCLUDING INSURANCE AND ALL OTHER PROPER EXPENSES.
title.vi: Luật quy định khoản ngân sách 2 triệu đô la theo Đạo luật số 696 không chỉ được dùng mua bạc thỏi để đúc đồng peso bạc Philippines mà còn chi trả chi phí đúc tiền, vận chuyển tiền xu đã đúc từ xưởng đúc tiền Hoa Kỳ đến quần đảo Philippines, bảo hiểm và các chi phí hợp lý khác.
title.th: กฎหมายกำหนดให้งบประมาณ 2 ล้านดอลลาร์ตามกฎหมายหมายเลข 696 ใช้ได้ทั้งเพื่อซื้อแท่งเงินสำหรับผลิตเหรียญเปโซเงินฟิลิปปินส์ และเพื่อชำระค่าใช้จ่ายในการผลิตเหรียญ การขนส่งเหรียญจากโรงกษาปณ์สหรัฐฯ ไปยังหมู่เกาะฟิลิปปินส์ ค่าประกันภัย และค่าใช้จ่ายที่เหมาะสมอื่น ๆ
title.id: Undang-undang yang menetapkan bahwa alokasi 2 juta dolar berdasarkan Undang-Undang Nomor 696 dapat digunakan bukan hanya untuk membeli batangan perak guna mencetak peso perak Filipina, tetapi juga untuk biaya pencetakan, pengangkutan koin dari percetakan uang Amerika Serikat ke Kepulauan Filipina, asuransi, dan biaya wajar lainnya.
title.ms: Akta menetapkan bahawa peruntukan AS$2 juta di bawah Akta No. 696 boleh digunakan bukan sahaja untuk membeli jongkong perak bagi menempa peso perak Filipina, tetapi juga untuk kos penempaan, pengangkutan syiling dari kilang wang Amerika Syarikat ke Kepulauan Filipina, insurans dan perbelanjaan lain yang munasabah.

text.en:
The appropriation of two millions of dollars provided for in section four of Act Numbered Six
hundred and ninety-six for the purchase of silver bullion to be coined into silver Philippine pesos may also
be expended for the expenses of coining the same, including the making of the necessary dies, for the
transportation of the coins, when coined, from the mints of the United States to the Philippine Islands, for
insurance, and for all other proper expenses of putting such pesos into circulation.

All moneys heretofore disbursed by the Disbursing Agent of the Philippine Government in
Washington tor the purposes mentioned in the preceding section are hereby ratified and confirmed.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 27, 1903.
